dct_title_s: Suggested extension of 8th Avenue North, and vacation of 6th Avenue North through Glenwood Park, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan depicting suggested changes to Sixth and Eighth Avenues North in relation to Glenwood Park, Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Twenty-ninth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page [109].
